exposure: Offering homebirth in the public maternity system
outcome: Inpatient costs around birth for mother and baby
cohort: The study utilized a dataset of all women who gave birth in Queensland, Australia, between July 2012 and June 2018, focusing on a subset of 36,314 women who gave birth between July 2017 and June 2018 and met low-risk pregnancy criteria.
finding: If 5% of women planning public hospital births instead planned homebirths through a publicly funded program, an estimated AU$303.13 per pregnancy could be saved by Queensland public hospitals and AU$186.94 by public hospital funders, totaling AU$11 million and AU$6.8 million annually, respectively.
cross-section timing: The microsimulation model compared costs for women who gave birth between July 2017 and June 2018.
